info.title: LasoTuVi API
info.description:
## Zi Wei Dou Shu (Purple Star Astrology) Chart API

Breaking v2 schema: English field names throughout.

### Features
* Solar ↔ lunar calendar conversion
* Full stem–branch (year / month / day / hour)
* Complete earth plate with structured stars (miao_wang, category)
* Chart formations (cách cục) and palace star interpretations
* Chart meta: natal element, life/body masters, generation/control
* Monthly luck via `view_year`
* Star reference catalog

### Usage
`POST /chart/generate` with birth info. Optional `view_year` for monthly luck.

is_solar.title: Is Solar
is_solar.description: True if Gregorian date, False if lunar

view_year.title: View Year
view_year.description: Year used for monthly luck overlay (Gregorian)

birth_place.description: Optional birth location for true solar time longitude correction

life_context.description: Optional marital/children context for Phu thê / Tử tức readings only

BirthInfoRequest.title: BirthInfoRequest
BirthInfoRequest.description: Birth data used to generate a chart.

StarInterpretation.title: StarInterpretation
StarInterpretation.description: Reading for one star in a palace (from the interpretation knowledge base).

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Geographic longitude in degrees (required when birth_place is set)

BirthPlace.title: BirthPlace
BirthPlace.description: Birth location for true-solar-time longitude correction.

marital_status.title: Marital Status
marital_status.description: single | married | divorced | remarried; omit/null = undisclosed

LifeContext.title: LifeContext
LifeContext.description: Optional life-context hints for spouse/children palace readings only.
